item.description:
Scroll follows your hand now: down is down, whatever the Mac's scroll setting. On the stepped EQ and the gain, one wheel click is one step.
A whole scroll is one undo step in Logic, not thirty.
Turn a pot and the pointer stays where you clicked it, in sight. Down is down there too.
Hover text shows up in Logic now, after five seconds. Right-click menus stay open until you pick something.
NOISE is the input plate's bottom screw. Small. Unlabelled. Hover to find out.
On LINE, the gain number stops at +18, where the gain does.
Quit Logic and this swaps itself in. Your songs come along.

Scroll follows your hand now: down is down, whatever the Mac's scroll setting. On the stepped EQ and the gain, one wheel click is one step.
A whole scroll is one undo step in Logic, not thirty.
The pointer stays where you clicked while you turn a pot, and it stays in sight.
Hover text and the value bubbles wait five seconds.
On LINE, the gain number stops at +18, where the gain does.
Quit Logic and this swaps itself in. Your songs come along.

The fader jumps on Option-click: to unity, and from unity all the way off. Double-click types a value again, like every other pot.
The manual is dark now, and it shows its work: how the console was measured, and the EQ curves from the sweeps.
Quit Logic and this swaps itself in. Your songs come along.
